reviews.comment: Really great lectures and surprisingly interesting material! Everything you need to know for exams is in his lectures. He's pretty lenient with grading the fully written exams if you understand all the concepts and have a fair amount of detail. I wrote incorrect details often, and he corrected them without taking too many points.

I have had a great time in this class. The material is very difficult, but very intriguing. It is evident that he loves this field deeply. The tests are fully written which is daunting, but doable. He grades fairly and cares about his students. Well worth the work!

He cares is you care, I did pretty poorly on the first exam but worked my way back. 20 points extra credit on each exam, if you average a B or higher with good attendance the final is exempted. Honestly, if you put in the work, and come with your mistakes he'll help you out. It does require work though since exams are all free answer. Good luck!

This is one of my favorite professors I have ever had. This is a difficult class, with the final grade only based on four exams. However, he offers 20 extra points on each exam and the ability to drop one exam. He is so knowledgeable in his field, passionate about the subject, and very understanding.

Great professor all the way around! The class was moderately difficult, but he has it so there are 4 exams, lowest grade gets dropped, and there are potential 20 points of extra credit for each exam. Dr. Riley is extremely knowledgeable about developmental biology and his lectures were always intriguing. He also really cares about his students.
When going to office hours, talks to you as if you should know everything. Slides are not helpful, must pay attention in class for notes. Not worth as Bio elective class.
Literally he is so knit picky when grading. He honestly seems like he barely understands his field also. The only good thing about him is that one exam is dropped
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really like Dr. Riley! He has 3 exams and 1 final. If you go to class he will drop your lowest exam. If you already have an A, you do not need to take the final. His class is lecture heavy, but the textbook is really useful. His tests are really fair and are out of 116 points be prepared to put in effort the tests cover A LOT of material!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All of your time will be devoted to this class and you still wont learn anything. Homework is participation but hell verbally degrade you for not understanding. He is cruel and demeaning and over half his class dropped. He keeps the class over time and adds new grade categories and tests middle of the semester. He doesnt respect you or your time
